# Price the winter, not the driveway.

> Price a snow-removal winter from route minutes, truck cost, salt, and expected storms. Compare per-push vs seasonal, see the ice-event drain, and the storm count where a cheap seasonal goes underwater.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
